about:
How to convert PDF to JPG

  1. Drop your PDF into the box.
  2. Pick a format and resolution — 150 DPI is sharp on any screen, 300 DPI is print quality.
  3. Optionally type the pages you need, like 1-3, 5.
  4. Download each page or all of them as a ZIP.

Scanned PDFs, Arabic text and embedded fonts are rendered with pdf.js, the same engine Firefox uses to show PDFs.

h1: Compress PDF — Make Scans Small Enough to Email
intro: Scanned contracts, phone-photo PDFs and image-heavy reports are often too big to email or upload. Compress them here — in your browser, without sending your documents to anyone — and see exactly how much smaller they get.
about:
Honest note: what this compressor does

Each page is re-drawn as a compressed image. That's what shrinks scans and photos dramatically — often 70–90%. The trade-off: text in the new PDF can't be selected or searched, and links are removed. For a PDF that is mostly typed text, the result may not be smaller, and the tool will tell you so.

Which level should I pick?

  • Strong — for upload limits (e.g. 2 MB government forms).
  • Balanced — readable on screen, good for email.
  • Light — closest to the original, for printing.
faq: Is it safe for confidential documents?
Yes — the PDF is processed in your browser and never uploaded.
Why didn't my PDF get smaller?
Text-only PDFs are already small; turning pages into images can't beat that. Keep the original.
